**Amsa:** B. *Zuciyar mutum girmanta kamar na dunkulalliyar hannunsa ce.*

**Tallaci:**  
Wanne B ya gabatawa kuskuren fahimta game da *zuciya* (photosynthesis) kacidda yake koyar da *carbon dioxide* (CO₂) tare da *ƙarfi* (leaves) don ƙwarewa *sunlight* kuma ya ƙira *glucose* da *oxygen*. A karkashin ilimin biyoloji, zuciya ce aiki na mutum (da suka bincika) don koyar da CO₂, *water* (H₂O), da *sunlight* kuma ya ƙira *glucose* (mata) da *oxygen* (oxygen). Kamar yake, CO₂ ya dace zuwa mutum tare da ƙarfi, kuma yake ƙira oxygen, kamar koyar da "dunkulalliyar hannunsa" (respiration) inda mutum su koyar da oxygen kuma su ƙira CO₂. 

**Kamata B ya iya bai:**
- **CO₂** (carbon dioxide) *yana da kuskuren fahimta* game da zuciya, kamar yake *dauke da ƙarfi* don koyar da su.
- **Sunlight** (sunlight) *yana da ƙarfi* don ƙira energy.
- **Oxygen** (oxygen) *yana da ƙarfi* don ƙira kuma *yauka zuwa ƙasa* (atmosphere).

**Kamata wasu B ya iya bai:**
- **A:** *Takan ƙara ƙarfi* (absorbs something through leaves) *kuma* "wasanni" (maybe water or nutrients) *kamar yake, ƙarfi yana da kuskuren koyar da CO₂*, lekun "wasanni" *kuma* "water" *kuma* "nutrients" *kafin koyar da CO₂*.
- **C:** *Zuciya tana sa jini ya ɗauki oxygen zuwa jiki* – *Oxygen* *yauka zuwa ƙasa*, *kuma* *mutum su koyar da su tare da ƙarfi*, *kuma* *su ƙira zuwa jiki* (blood) *tare da ƙwarewa* (respiration).

**Tallaci:**  
Malamar ke amfani da **lura da jagoranta** (observation and analysis) domin sanyar yaran tasowa. Wanne da ke nuna cewa sun tattara nau’oin ganyen furanni (lura), sun kwatanta siffofi (jagoranta), da sun saka ganyen furannin a cikin kwano (eksperimen). Wanne da ke samun yana da ƙungiyar **lura** (observation) da **jagoranta** (analysis) kuma ke samun **eksperimen** (experiment) wanda ke nuna cewa suke amfani da **metoda ilimin kimiyya** (scientific method).  

**Kamata:**  
- **Lura da jagoranta** (B) ke samun yana da ƙungiyar amfani da **lura** (tattara nau’oin) da **jagoranta** (kwatanta siffofi), wanda ke samun cikin aiki.

- **Kwatanta bayanai** (D) ke nuna amfani da data, amma yana da ƙungiyar **lura da jagoranta**.

**Amsa:** B. Canjin ƙanƙara zuwa tururi ta sanadiyar aikin Rana

**Bayani:**  
Narrative text (yanayi) yana da ƙungiyoyin kimiyya kamar:  
1. **Kimiyya** – Yanayi yana da kimiyya (Rana) da aikin su (canjin ƙanƙara).  
2. **Aiki da ƙungiyoyin** – Aiki yana da ƙungiyoyin (canjin ƙanƙara zuwa tururi) da suka amfani da *tururi* (mataki) da *sanadiyar aikin* (wata lokaci).  
3. **Tatsari** – Yanayi yana nuna wani aiki da suka amfani da *zuwa* (hakkin) da *ta* (kafin), wanda yana nuna ƙungiyoyin da suka amfani da *tururi* da *sanadiyar aikin*.  

**Kullum:**  
- **A** da **C** yana da *faduwar* da *sanyin*, wanda yana nuna descriptive text (yanayi na ƙarfi).  
- **D** yana da *jikewar*, wanda yana nuna natural event, kuma bai yana da kimiyya.  
- **B** yana da kimiyya (Rana), aiki (canjin ƙanƙara), da mataki (tururi), wanda yana nuna narrative text.

**Amsa:**  
**A. Tarawa (Sublimation)**  

**Bayan:**  
Sublimation (Tarawa) ce wani aiki na kimiyya inda abu (solid) yana badawa zuwa gas don kafin badawa zuwa liki (liquid). Manki, kafin sublimation ke kowace kimiyya na daskararre (solid) badawa zuwa gas, kamar dry ice (CO₂ solid) yana badawa zuwa gas don kafin.  

**Kullum:**  
- **B. Condensation (Tarwada)**: Gas badawa zuwa liki.  
- **C. Evaporation (Bushewa)**: Liki badawa zuwa gas.  
- **D. Melting (Fuzarwa)**: Daskararre badawa zuwa liki.  

**Sauyin yanayi** na kwarewa (solid → gas) **ke sublimation**.

**Amsa:** D. Yanayi, iska, da hazo

**Harafin:**  
A cikin matsayin "Duniya Ta," malami ya kamata ya la'akari da **yanayi** (theme), **iska** (character), da **hazo** (conflict) kamar abubuwan muhimman cikin abinci. Yanayi yana nuna idanin rawaya, iska yana nuna wajen ƙwallon ƙasa, da hazo yana nuna ƙungiyar ƙasa-ƙasa au ƙungiyar ƙasa da ƙungiyar. Wanne su ne kamar abubuwan muhimman cikin abinci, kamar kungiyoyin kimiyya da suka bincika. Kamar haka, **D** ce amsa da ke samar.

**Amsa:** D. Canjin yanayin zafin teku  

**Tallaci:**  
Boiling (raƙuman ruwa) ya kamata canjin yanayin zafin teku (phase change) don ruwa, kamar yadda ruwa (liquid) ya canji zuwa gas (vapor). A cikin kimiyya, lokacin da ruwa ya koyoyi, kina matukar (kinetic energy) na masu molekula na ruwa ya zai da dacewa don canji zuwa zafin gas. Lokacin da kina matukar ya koyoyi zuwa dacewa, molekula su ya canji zuwa zafin gas, kuma su ya ƙidaya a cikin form na bubbles.  

**Matsayin babban dalilin:**  
- **Canjin yanayin zafin teku** (Option D) ya kamata babban dalilin kimiyya game da boiling, kamar yadda ruwa ya canji zuwa gas.  
- **Bambance-bambancen zafin sararin samaniya** (Option C) ya kamata kina matukar, amma kina matukar ya kamata babban dalilin, amma canjin zafin teku wajen babban dalilin.  
- **Ƙarfin jan hankali na Wata** (Option B) amma koyi, kamin kamin ruwa ya canji zuwa gas, amma ruwa yana da zafin hankali kafin.  
- **Iskan** (Option A) amma koyi, amma koyi kuma babban dalilin.  

**Hakiman:** D. Canjin yanayin zafin teku.

**Amsa:** D. A lokacin wasa a fili, Soledad ta murza wasu iri a hannunta ta ce: Mai kaifi.

**Bayani:**  
Wannan aiki ne kamar kwarewar bincike na *tragic hero* (ƙarewa mai motsi), kamar kuma kwarewar *hamartia* (karkata mai motsi). A cikin karkin Soledad, koyin "Mai kaifi" (kamar "I caused it" / "Shin kaifi") yana nuna cewa karkata su yana da ƙamshi mai motsi, kuma suka koyi daga cikin su. Wannan yana samun *hubris* (zaki) ko *self-inflicted downfall*, kamar koyin bincike na kimiyya.  

**Kasancewa:**  
- **A** da **B** da **C** za su nuna aikin kusur, leda, ko ƙarfi, kuma su koyi kusur mai motsi.  
- **D** yana nuna karkata mai motsi (Soledad) da suka koyi daga cikin su, kuma suka kalla daga kusur su, kamar koyin bincike na kimiyya.  

**Karin ƙarewa:**

**Amsa:** A. Cushe-zama-da-yawa (Mutualism)

**Bayani:** 
- **Clownfish (Binciken)** da **Anemone (Anemone na teku)** yana da **kushe-zama-da-yawa**, kamar yadda koyi da koyi yana **zama**. 
  - **Clownfish** yana **zama** saboda **anemone** yana **korar mucus** wanda **baya** su (koyi da koyi yana **zama**).
  - **Anemone** yana **zama** saboda **clownfish** yana **sanyar farin** wanda **baya** su (koyi da koyi yana **zama**).
- **Amensalism (B)** yana nuna **wannan kifaye** inda **wata kwarewa** yana **korar daƙi** da **koyi** yana **zama**, kamar yadda **wata kwarewa** yana **korar daƙi** da **koyi** yana **zama** (koyi yana **zama**, koyi yana **zama**).
- **Bangaranci (C)** yana nuna **wannan kifaye** inda **wata kwarewa** yana **zama** da **koyi** yana **daƙi**, kamar yadda **parasite** yana **zama** da **host** yana **daƙi**.
- **Tsarin Hulɗa Mai Amfani Ga Juna (D)** yana nuna **wannan kifaye** inda **wata kwarewa** yana **zama** da **koyi** yana **zama**, kamar yadda **wata kwarewa** yana **zama** da **koyi** yana **zama**.

**Kusan:** Koyi da koyi yana **zama** (clownfish da anemone), kamar yadda **clownfish** yana **zama** don **anemone** da **anemone** yana **zama** don **clownfish**. Kafin, **kushe-zama-da-yawa** (A) ce **wata kwarewa** tare da **koyi** yana **zama**. 

**Kamata:** Amsa **B (Amensalism)** yana **daƙi**, koyi da koyi yana **zama**. Kafin, **kushe-zama-da-yawa (A)** ce **wata kwarewa** tare da **koyi** yana **zama**.

**Amsa:**  
**B. Ƙwayoyin cuta na da illa ga rayayyun halittu**  

**Bayan:**  
Tambayoyin probiotics (kamar *Lactobacillus* da *Bifidobacterium*) suna sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta (gut flora) don kusanci kimiyya, kuma suna dace da ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya. Lokacin da kake, ƙwayoyin cuta wanda ke cikin gishiri ya nuna *illa* (masu zuwa) ga rayayyun halittu kamar:  
- **Kusanci kimiyya da ƙwayoyin cuta** (probioyin suna sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya).  
- **Dakaka daga ƙwayoyin cuta** (probioyin suna dace da ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya).  
- **Sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya** (probioyin suna sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya).  

Tambaya **B** yana nuna cewa ƙwayoyin cuta (gut flora) wajen kusanci kimiyya, kamar probioyin, ya nuna *illa* ga rayayyun halittu. Wannan yana da ƙungiyar kimiyya kamar:  
1. **Kusanci kimiyya** – Ƙwayoyin cuta yana da ƙungiyar kimiyya kamar sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya.  
2. **Sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta** – Probioyin suna sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya.  
3. **Dakaka daga ƙwayoyin cuta** – Probioyin suna dace da ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya.  

Tambayoyin **A, C, da D** za su iya iya amfani da probioyin, lekun **B** yana nuna ƙungiyar kimiyya na ƙwayoyin cuta (gut flora) game da rayayyun halittu, kamar probioyin. Wannan yana da ƙungiyar kimiyya kamar:  
- **Probioyin suna sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta** (A) – Wannan yana nuna ƙungiyar probioyin game da ƙwayoyin cuta, lekun yana da ƙungiyar kimiyya.  
- **Ƙwayoyin cuta yana da ƙungiyar kimiyya** (B) – Wannan yana nuna ƙungiyar ƙwayoyin cuta game da rayayyun halittu, kamar probioyin.  

**Kamar haka, B** yana da ƙungiyar kimiyya kamar probioyin da suka sauƙaƙa ƙwayoyin cuta don kusanci kimiyya.

**Amsa:** C

**Tallaci:**  
Wanne da ke bai ɗalibai malamar don cimma burinta na *transgenic organisms* (ƙwayoyin halitta) wajen ilimin halittar ƙwayoyin halitta (cell biology) ce **C. Bincike na ka'ida game da jiyya ta kwayoyin halitta a maganin cututtuka**. 

**Tallaci daidai:**  
- **A. Gabatarwa da ke nuna canje-canjen da dabarun kilona suka samu** – Daban-daban, koyi ce amfani da *transgenic organisms* (kamar canje kilona daga wani halitta zuwa fara), kuma suka tantance amfani da kwayoyin halitta.  
- **B. Shiryawa ko ƙirƙirar wani hoto-fosta a kan dabarun samar da halittu masu canjin kwayoyin halitta** – Daban-daban, koyi ce amfani da *transgenic organisms* don nuna halaye.  
- **C. Bincike na ka'ida game da jiyya ta kwayoyin halitta a maganin cututtuka** – Bincike da ke bai ɗalibai, koyi ce amfani da *cututtuka* (jiyya) don nuna *transgenic organisms*, kuma koyi ce amfani da *cututtuka* don nuna *transgenic organisms*.  
- **D. Makala kan amfani da ƙwayoyin halitta na asali wajen magance cututtuka** – Daban-daban, koyi ce amfani da *transgenic organisms* don nuna *cututtuka*.  

**Kamar yadda koyi ce, C.**

**Amsa:** C

**Tallaci:**  
Plasmolysis yana nufin kammalci ruwan dacewa don koyoyin kimiyya a cikin seli na ƙarfi (kamar seli na ƙarfi) inda seli yana da ruwa a cikin da aka ɣamnaya a ruwan da ke da ƙarfi (hypertonic solution). Wannan yana kammalci ruwan dacewa don koyoyin kimiyya, kuma seli yana ƙasa da ruwa, kuma membranin seli yana ƙasa daga waliyar seli. 

**Tallaci da Ayyukan C:**  
- **Karas da aka riga a cikin ruwan da aka tace (sugar solution):** Ruwan da aka tace yana da ƙarfi (hypertonic), kuma yana kammalci ruwan dacewa don koyoyin kimiyya a cikin seli na karas.  
- **Tsawon kwana biyu:** Wannan yana ƙasa da ruwan dacewa don koyoyin kimiyya, kuma seli yana ƙasa da ruwa, kuma yana ƙasa daga waliyar seli (plasmolysis).  
- **Sake latsashi bayan an cire shi daga ruwan:** A cire karas daga ruwan yana ƙasa da ƙarfi, kuma yana ƙasa da plasmolysis. 

**Ayyukan A, B, da D:**  
- **A da B:** Meat (animal tissue) yana da seli na ƙarfi, kuma plasmolysis yana nufin kammalci ruwan dacewa don koyoyin kimiyya a cikin seli na ƙarfi.  
- **D:** Leaf a ruwan mai tsafta (hypotonic) yana kammalci ruwan dacewa don koyoyin kimiyya, kuma seli yana ƙasa da ruwa (turgid), kuma yana ƙasa da plasmolysis. 

**Kan kuma:** Ayyukan **C** yana nufin ƙammalci plasmolysis domin karas a cikin ruwan da aka tace.

   Malami yana tantance cewa *halittu masu rai* (masu zuwa) suna kwatanta *kwayoyin halitta guda ɗaya* (tissues of different types) da suka *tsara* (found) cikin *kyallen jiki, gabobi, da tsarin jiki* (parts, organs, and systems) a jikin ɗan Adam. 2. **Tallakin Ayyukan:**  
   - **A (Suna kwatanta kyallen jiki na salula...):**

   - **B (Suna fahimtar cewa kowace ƙwayar halitta tana fitowa ne daga wata ƙwayar halitta...):**  
     Yana nuna cewa *kowace ƙwayar halitta* (organ systems) tana fitowa daga *wata ƙwayar halitta* (one tissue type), kamar kuma yana nuna *fitowa* (development), kamar kuma yana ƙidaya daga aiki na tantance.

     Yana nuna *sel* (cells) da *ayyukan sel* (functions of cells), kamar kuma yana ƙidaya daga aiki na tantance.

**Harafin:**

FSH da LH ce wajen **kwayayen mahaifa (uterine cycle)**, lekun **dakaka** wajen **ovarian cycle** (kamar kwayayen follicular, ovulation, da luteal phase). Kowace aiki na GnRH **kafin kwayayen mace (ovarian cycle)**, kuma suka **dakaka** wajen **kwayayen mahaifa**. Kamar haka, **option C** ce amsa da ke samun, koyi cewa GnRH **dakaka** wajen **ovarian cycle**.  

**Option D** ce amsa da ke **kwayayen mahaifa**, wanda ke **haila** don **kwayayen mace** (kamar estrogen da progesterone). Kowace **kafin** aiki na GnRH, lekun **option C** ce amsa da ke **dakaka** aiki na GnRH **dangane da ovarian cycle**.

A cikin aiki na batir ɗin lantarki (electrolysis) na narkararren gishirin sodium chloride (NaCl) a ƙasa (Downs cell), kowace ƙarfe (ions) suna motsawa zuwa kowane kwarewa don ɗauke da aiki. 

- **Sodium ions (Na⁺)** yana motsawa zuwa **cathode** (kwarewa na reduction) ta hanyar **reduction** don samun **sodium metal** (D).

- **C** (Chloride ions migrate to the anode for oxidation) **da** **D** (Sodium ions migrate to the cathode to be reduced) **kowane kuma ce aiki da ke samun**.  

**Lemu:**  
Idan aikin da ke nuna **kowane aiki** (C da D) **kuma ce aiki da ke samun**, kamar yadda ake amfani da **Downs cell**, **D** yana samun **hanyar kwarewa na cathode**, kuma **C** yana samun **hanyar kwarewa na anode**.

Tare da kungiyar ilimi, wasu sifofin abubuwa kamar *ƙamshi* (conductivity), *kafin ƙarfi* (hardness), *kafin ƙarar* (transparency), da *kafin ƙarar ruwa* (buoyancy) ya kamar halin da suka amfani da su a kimiyya.  

**Mai amfani da B:**  
- **Ƙarfi (metal):** Ƙamshi da kafin ƙarfi.  
- **Haske (glass):** Kafin ƙarar da kafin ƙarfi.  
- **Zafi (water):** Kafin ƙarar ruwa da kafin ƙamshi.  
- **Ruwa (wood):** Kafin ƙarfi da kafin ƙarar ruwa.  

**Mai amfani da A, C, D:**  
- **A:** Tsaye amfani da abubuwa a wasu hali, kamar ƙarfi a kafin ƙamshi, haske a kafin ƙarar, kuma ruwa a kafin ƙarar ruwa.  
- **C:** Tsaye nau’o’in abubuwa a rayuwar yau, kamar ƙarfi a kafin ƙamshi, haske a kafin ƙarar.  
- **D:** Tsaye amfani da abubuwa a wasu aiki, kamar ƙarfi a kafin ƙamshi, haske a kafin ƙarar.  

**Kamar yadda kungiyar ilimi ta nuna:**  
Malami ya tantance sifofin abubuwa don kafin iya iya amfani da su a kimiyya. Kamar halin da ƙarfi yana da ƙamshi, haske yana da ƙarar, zafi yana da ƙarar ruwa, da ruwa yana da ƙarar ruwa.  

**Kafin:**  
**B** ce amsa da ke samun kungiyar ilimi domin tantance sifofin abubuwa.

Tambayoyin C zai bai wa ɗalibai domin cimma manufar koyo game da **ƙwayar halitta ta prokaryotic** da **eukaryotic** tare da amfani da **tsarin tashin farko**. Wanne yana iya baiwa kuma farko na **komplikasen** da **funshin** don ƙwayar halitta ta eukaryotic (kamar ƙwayar halitta na **mammal** da **bitan**) da ƙwayar halitta ta prokaryotic (kamar **bakteriya**).

- **Membran plasma** (wajen don ƙwayar halitta).  
- **Ribosom** (wajen don ƙwayar halitta, amma farko na **size** da **funshin**).  

Wanne tambayoyin yana iya baiwa **kowace farko** na **funshin** kamar **fotosintesis** (wajen ƙwayar halitta ta eukaryotic kamar **chloroplast**), amma **bakteriya** yana iya yi wajen **membran plasma**. **Bayan:** 

Solubility na gishirin ionic (kamar NaCl da NaHCO₃) ya fada ne ga **lattice energy** (kwayoyin halitta) da **hydration energy** (kwayoyin narkarwa) na ions. Lattice energy ya fada ne ga **size** da **charge** na ions. Cl⁻ (daga NaCl) ya da size kusanta kuma ya da kwayoyin halitta kusanta, don haka lattice energy na NaCl ya da kusanta. HCO₃⁻ (daga NaHCO₃) ya da size kusanta kuma ya da kwayoyin halitta kusanta, don haka lattice energy na NaHCO₃ ya da kusanta. 

Hydration energy, kuma, ya fada ne ga **size** da **charge** na ions. Cl⁻, kamar lattice energy, ya da hydration energy kusanta, don haka narkarwa ya fada. HCO₃⁻, kamar lattice energy, ya da hydration energy kusanta, don haka narkarwa ya kusanta. 

**NaCl** ya da **lattice energy kusanta** kuma **hydration energy kusanta**, don haka **solubility ya fada**. **NaHCO₃** ya da **lattice energy kusanta** kuma **hydration energy kusanta**, don haka **solubility ya kusanta**. 

**Wanne kwayoyin ya fada ne?**  
Lattice energy na NaHCO₃ (kamar HCO₃⁻) ya da kusanta, kuma hydration energy ya da kusanta. Don haka, **difference in hydration energy** (C) ya fada ne ga solubility difference. HCO₃⁻, kamar ion kusanta, ya da kwayoyin narkarwa kusanta, don haka narkarwa ya kusanta. Cl⁻, kamar ion kusanta, ya da kwayoyin narkarwa kusanta, don haka narkarwa ya fada. 

**Kuskuren fahimta:**  
Students suka amfani da **number of ions** (A) kuma **ionic bond strength** (B), lekun **hydration energy** (C) ya fada ne ga solubility difference. Lattice energy (B) ya da role, lekun hydration energy (C) ya fada ne ga narkarwa.

**C. Me yasa muke yawan magana game da abubuwa masu zafi da sanyi, a wannan yanayin, game da gilashi mai sanyi da gilashi mai zafi?**

---

**Tafsiri:**  
A kimiyyar zafin halitta (thermochemistry), ƙungiyoyin kafa (calorimeter) yana da wajen kafin zafi daga abubuwan masu zafi (kamar ƙanƙar) da suka yi sanyi (kamar ruwa). A wannan ƙwarewa, ƙanƙar da ruwa yana da alaƙa (20°C), kuma ba za ta yi sanyi ba a lokacin ranar kaka. Wanne da ke nuna wani ƙanƙar da ruwa ba zai yi sanyi ba yana da ƙungiyoyin kafa mai ƙanƙara (insulated) da suka kafin zafi.  

**Tambaya C** yana da ƙungiyoyin kafin yin la'akari da:  
- **Magana game da abubuwa masu zafi (kamar ƙanƙar) da abubuwa masu sanyi (kamar ruwa)**: Idan ƙanƙar da ruwa yana da **magana na zafi (specific heat capacity)** mai sama, su zai yi sanyi mai sama, kuma ƙungiyoyin kafa ba zai yi sanyi ba.  
- **Magana game da gilashi mai sanyi (water) da gilashi mai zafi (metal)**: Ƙanƙar (metal) kamar ƙanƙar alimin yana da **magana na zafi** mai ƙasa (kamar 0.385 J/g°C), don haka, idan yake da **magana na zafi** mai ƙasa, su zai yi sanyi mai ƙasa.  

**Wanne da ke nuna** ƙanƙar da ruwa **ba zai yi sanyi ba** yana da **magana na zafi** mai sama, kuma ƙungiyoyin kafa yana da **magana na zafi** mai ƙanƙara. Tambaya C yana da wajen ƙungiyoyin kafin yin la'akari da **magana na zafi** don ƙungiyoyin kafa, ƙanƙar, da ruwa, kuma yana da wajen ƙungiyoyin kafin yin la'akari da **wani ƙanƙar da ruwa yana da magana na zafi mai sama**.  

**Tambayoyi A, B, da D** yana da ƙungiyoyin kafin yin la'akari da ƙungiyoyin kafa, alaƙa, da system/surroundings, kuma ba yana da wajen yin la'akari da **magana na zafi** don ƙungiyoyin kafa, ƙanƙar, da ruwa.

Tambaya C yana da wajen yin la'akari da **magana na zafi** don ƙungiyoyin kafa, ƙanƙar, da ruwa, kuma yana da wajen yin la'akari da **wani ƙanƙar da ruwa yana da magana na zafi mai sama**.

---

**Bayan:**  
Wanne aiki na yau yana da hubba ga **"ya'yan itace"** (tambayoyin rawaya) da suka amfani da azanci (kamar rawaya, lemu, pear, da kamshi) don bayyana kimiyya na bincike. Amsa **C** yana nuna amfani da **azanci** don **shafar saurin mu'amala** (kamar rawaya, lemu, pear, kamshi) a cikin analisis. Kowace tambayoyi ne yana **nuna hubbin azanci da kimiyya** (masu kimiyya kamar rawaya, lemu, pear, kamshi) don **shafar wasan tambayoyin rawaya**. 

- **Amsa A** yana da amfani da **sulace** ("Wace 'ya'yan itace ce...") kuma bishiyoyin da ke nuna **kimiyya** (rawaya, lemu, pear, kamshi) kuma bishiyoyin da ke nuna **azanci** (rawaya, lemu, pear, kamshi) yana da **hubba daidaitawa**, kuma yana **kalla** da **shafar wasan tambayoyin rawaya**.  
- **Amsa B** yana da amfani da **azanci** (rawaya, lemu, pear, kamshi) kuma yana **shafar wasan tambayoyin rawaya**, amma **bawon tambayoyin** yana da **hubba daidaitawa**.  
- **Amsa D** yana da amfani da **hubbin kimiyya da azanci** (kamar "lokacin da kake cin ɓangaren lemu, ka ji daɗi ko rashin daɗi?"), amma **bawon tambayoyin** yana da **hubba daidaitawa**.

- **Option A** ya nuna "ruwan sama mai guba" (acid rain) kuma ya rubuta sulfuric acid, kamar haka, ya kasance redox, amma ya kuma ya iya iya nuna oxidation na sulfur.

**C. Ku bai wa ɗalibai bayanan game da wuraren tafasasshen ruwa na hydrocarbons masu tsawon sarƙa-sarƙa daban-daban da aka tsara a cikin teburi kuma ku sa su fassara yanayin da aka gani bisa ga mu'amalar da kwayoyin halittar suka nuna.**

---

**Tafsiri:**  
Wannan aiki yana da hubbokin **tafasawar hydrocarbons** (kamar ruwa, iska, gas) tare da **boiling points** (zafin ɗaki) da suka farko. Tsarin aiki da ke nuna yana da hubbokin **fractional distillation** (tafasawar ƙarfi), wanda ke amfani da farko zafin ɗaki don raba abubuwan masu farko. 

- **Option C** yana nuna cewa:  
  1. **Heating the mixture** (shirya da fassara) – kowane hydrocarbon yana ɗauke da zafin ɗaki farko.  
  2. **Vaporization** – ruwa yana ɗauke da ƙarfi (gas) tare da zafin ɗaki.  
  3. **Condensation at different temperatures** – abubuwan masu zafin ɗaki farko yana ɗauke da ƙarfi farko, kuma su yana ɗauke da **pear** (collection) a cikin teburi.  

**Munyari:**  
- **Option A** yana nuna cewa "shirya da fassara" kuma "suna cikin yanayi mai karko, ruwa, ko iska" – wadannan yana da hubbokin **simple distillation**, kamar yadda za su raba abubuwan masu zafin ɗaki farko, amma **fractional distillation** yana da teburi don raba abubuwan masu zafin ɗaki farko daban-daban.  
- **Option B** yana nuna "cooling" – wadannan yana da hubbokin **condensation**, amma yake da **fractional distillation**.  
- **Option D** yana nuna "filtration" – wadannan yana da hubbokin **size-based separation**, amma yake da **boiling point-based separation**.  

**Kamar yadda za a iya nuna**, **Option C** yana nuna cewa aiki yana amfani da **fractional distillation**, wanda yana tantance gabobin **boiling points** da suka farko don raba hydrocarbons.
